decisions.reason: The combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot is still early in its lifecycle, shares its engineering platform with the other robots, and costs little to keep while its value in the firm's automated circulation offer remains open.
The automatic de-shuttering robot is a modular building block of the integrated precast lines, and two years of evidence on a long-cycle capital good is too little to justify abandoning the option.
The profile storage robot completes the shuttering robot cell at low marginal carrying cost, so keeping it preserves upside from rising automation demand.
The automatic shuttering robot is central to the firm's strategic push toward automated precast production, and its value is still unresolved, so the option stays open.
The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting machine line was launched only in 2024 and builds on established technology, so its uncertainty is high and keeping it is cheap.
The production analysis software has near-zero carrying cost, complements the firm's controls and lifecycle services, and its value is still emerging.
